name: Asakura Nobunaga
source:
Nobunaga is a childhood friend of [url=/c10817]Yuuto[/url] who attends the same private high school, though is in the class next to his. He has a cheerful and openhearted personality, gets very good grades, and is considered a [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bish%C5%8Dnen]bishounen[/url] by the female students. However, he is a hardcore otaku and is familiar with the layout of Akihabara. He is extremely famous in various places in Akihabara. Due to his enormous amount of purchases, he is known as "Kaiser" at the Animate store, and is one of three people who possesses the golden Animate card. At a maid café where [url=/c10808]Haruka[/url] once worked part time called "@Home ~Café", there is a picture of him shaking hands with the manager of the café, framed in gold with the caption "Welcome home, our greatest master" hung in the center of the café. Covertly, he knows what is going on between Yuuto and Haruka.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nogizaka_Haruka_no_Himitsu#Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
